date_selection: UTC 4th of six unused months, different from previous Stage12-23 frozen research dates; all locked before returns

source.ground_truth: Binance official Spot monthly 1h Klines ZIP with published SHA256, 168 contiguous bars from date 06:00 UTC
source.watch: Binance official Spot daily 1m ZIP and publisher SHA256 for 60h, original V4 observe_snapshot/process_queue
source.watch_window: Date 06:00–18:00 UTC only; never claim 168h watch window
source.trading_proxy: V4 original 24h exit price proxy, 3m delayed entry, 10bps fee per side and 20bps slippage per side, not an actual fill

predetermined_analysis.primary_denominator: Both complete verified168h hourly ground truth and complete verified60h original V4 minute source
predetermined_analysis.hourly_cross_time_rule: WATCH time strictly earlier than START of first 2x/5x hour qualifies as unambiguous early; within same first-crossing hour is ambiguous, not early
predetermined_analysis.recall_scope: ONLY 06:00-18:00 fixed-window early discovery of FUTURE 7d 2x/5x; NOT full 7d alert recall
predetermined_analysis.watch_volume: All V4 WATCH episodes on valid 60h across universe and joint subset
predetermined_analysis.non2x_watch: REPORT WATCH without confirmed 7d gross2x, DO NOT auto-label trade false positive
predetermined_analysis.source_missing: Monthly GT 404 and 168h gaps, daily 1m 404 and 60h gaps separately censored
predetermined_analysis.network_integrity: All source integrity or transient API failures ABORT, never treat source errors as negatives
predetermined_analysis.original_watch_24h_price_proxy: Full cohort proxy cost metrics including zero-trade/censored, no orderbook or real fills
